Name: annealed_subtree_search
Title: Simulated Annealing over Expression Trees for Symbolic Law Discovery
Experiment: Replace uniform random search in propose_candidate with simulated annealing: maintain a current tree, propose local edits (replace a random subtree with a fresh random subtree, change an operator, or swap a leaf), accept by the Metropolis criterion on log-NRMSE with a geometric temperature schedule, and restart from a fresh random tree when stuck. Compare solve rate, verified rate, and evals_to_solve against the random-search baseline across all benchmarks.
